evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform

value.quotedAs: Bank receipt about the transfer of the application fee

evidence.quote: Valid, filled-in application form (to be filled online here); If already graduated: certificate of education (school leaving qualification such as high school diploma, document of graduation or any equivalent; university degree certificate or any equivalent; all in English / translated); Students in their final year of education: transcripts (end of year reports) of the last 2-3 academic years, plus predicted grades / expected graduation certificate. Certificate or proof of citizenship and/or permanent residence (e.g. passport) Short Resume/CV (personal details, educational background, work experience, language skills, additional skills) Medical Certificate - please see a template here Bank receipt about the transfer of the application fee of 150 USD (non-refundable)

notes: Tuition fee not extracted because the programme page states 7,000 USD/Year, which is not in EUR or HUF as required by the task. The application deadline (15th June) is recurring because no year is given. An intake for February is not listed because the programme page says it starts only in September.

evidence.quote: a B2 level English proficiency is required
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513
an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5

rules.note: Des examens d'entrée en mathématiques et en physique (écrit et oral) sont requis. Préparez-vous en conséquence.
